title: ReliableShards
description: This adds shards currency to your server, inspired from DonutSMP, but has conversion.
body:
**ReliableShard** is a powerful, premium-currency shop plugin designed for Spigot/Paper servers. It allows players to convert their standard Vault economy money into a high-value currency called Shards, which can be used to purchase exclusive, custom items through a beautifully designed GUI.

Whether you want to sell Crate Keys, custom enchanted gear, or Spawners with complex NBT data, ReliableShard handles it perfectly without requiring you to manually configure item data in text files.

## ✨ Key Features
**In-Game Custom Item Setup**: No more messing with complex config files to recreate custom items. Admins can simply hold any item (including crate keys, spawners, or items with complex NBT data) and type /rs sell <price>. The plugin instantly saves it to the shop with 100% accuracy.

**Aesthetic Paginated Shop**: The shop features a clean, bordered GUI with a 4x7 interior grid. It automatically paginates your items and prevents UI clutter.

**Live Search System**: Players can type /rs search <item> to instantly filter the shop GUI and find exactly what they are looking for.

**Global Discounts**: Host server-wide sales! Admins can type /rs discount <percentage> to dynamically discount everything in the shop. The GUI will automatically cross out the old price and show the new sale price.

**Multi-Language Support**: Fully customizable messages. Out of the box, it supports English, Tagalog, Japanese, Chinese, French, German, and Indonesian.

## 📦 Dependencies
**Vault (Required)** - For economy conversion.

**LuckPerms (Required)** - For permission handling.

**PlaceholderAPI** (Optional but recommended) - To display Shard balances on scoreboards and holograms.

🛠️ Commands & Permissions
Player Commands (Public by default)




```
/rs - Opens the Shard Shop.

/rs balance - View your current Shard balance.

/rs search <name> - Search for specific items in the shop.

/rs convert - Buy 1 Shard using standard Vault money.

Admin Commands (rs.admin)

/rs sell <amount> - Adds the item you are currently holding to the Shard Shop.

/rs remove - Opens the shop in Remove Mode to delete items.

/rs give <player> <amount> - Give Shards to a player.

/rs discount <0-100> - Set a server-wide percentage discount on the shop.

/rs reload - Reloads the config, data, and language files without restarting the server.

/rs rate - Changes the conversion rate.

```

(Note: Server owners can also grant granular permissions like rs.sell, rs.give, rs.remove, etc., to specific moderator ranks).

📊 Placeholders
Use these in your scoreboards (like TAB or FeatherBoard) or chat formatting plugins:


```
%reliableshard_balance%
```
 - Returns the player's formatted balance (e.g., 1.5k).


```
%reliableshard_balance_raw%
```
 - Returns the exact integer (e.g., 1500).
